guideline: The evaluation criteria were designed based on three dimensions: (1) Accuracy-whether the keyphrases accurately captured the core content of the post. (2) Relevance-whether the keyphrases were relevant to the post's content and intent. (3) Usefulness-whether the keyphrase, when used as a hashtag, aids in the dissemination or categorization of the post.
Annotators rated each generated keyphrase on criteria such as usefulness for dissemination and overall relevance; ratings were averaged to produce final scores.
